name: Sandbar
description: Low bars of drifted sand banking up against one edge or the other, over a ruled shoal.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @pick(0%, 30%); top: 34%; width: @pick(40%, 70%, 100%); height: 32%; border-radius: 999px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @random(0.4) { -webkit-box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
